official_feature_bridge.scope: Feature-only expansion of the authorized 510-player BDB population. This does not turn the historical Combine pool into full trajectories or establish scouting accuracy.

summary: Expanded to 2,533 drafted prospects and 66 public data archives. Source-guarded college inputs reduce retrospective two-season NFL usage error by 2.53% versus Combine traits; the interval includes zero, college-linked controls do not confirm it, and custom metrics add no dependable benefit. No scouting edge or pressure-rate improvement is established.
